_schema._comment: The curated half of the commitments board. Every row must carry a real source URL and the date the statement was made - this register is never populated from recollection. The CLAIMED lane on the page fills itself from live headlines and needs no maintenance; this file is for promises worth tracking properly.
_schema.id: stable slug, kept identifiable across edits
_schema.statement: what was said, as close to verbatim as possible
_schema.source_url: REQUIRED - primary source, or the report of it
_schema.target_value: numeric goal, or null when the goal is an event rather than a quantity
_schema.unit: satellites | vehicles | GWh | flights/day | acres | null
_schema.target_date: YYYY-MM-DD deadline; the END of the stated window
_schema.metric: key in the live metrics dict that measures this, or null if unmeasurable
_schema.notes: context, prior slips, why it matters

targets.statement: Construction begins on Starbase Louisiana, a 125,000-acre spaceport at Pecan Island, Vermilion Parish
targets.notes: $100B committed, plus $20M upfront and $25M/yr for 25 years under a local PILOT agreement. Over 3,000 direct jobs projected across the decade.
Two years after the stated construction start. Watch this one against the Starbase Texas precedent.

targets.statement: Over a dozen launch towers, enabling more than 30 Starship flights per day, making it the biggest launch site on Earth
targets.notes: No date attached to the flight-rate claim - only 'at full buildout'. For scale, SpaceX currently flies roughly 13 orbital launches per MONTH across all vehicles, so this is a claim about a different order of operation, not an increment. Deliberately left unmeasured rather than scored against a deadline nobody stated.

targets.statement: Terafab, a 100-million-square-foot semiconductor plant in Grimes County, Texas; $16.8B first phase
targets.notes: Joint venture of Tesla, SpaceX, xAI and Intel. A SpaceX regulatory filing suggests the multi-phase total could reach $119B. No completion date stated in the announcement - add one here when the company gives one.
